questions: What is memory?
When memory fails, is the information necessarily gone for good?
What is drive?
If the drive is lost, does movement stop?
What is arousal?
If arousal rises, does performance always improve?
What is resistance?
If resistance rises, does less get through?
What is plasticity?
If plasticity is lost, does it become brittle?
What is extinction?
After extinction, is it gone forever?
What is adaptation?
Once adaptation occurs, does it stay that way?
What is release?
After release, does it stay available?
What is charge?
If the charge is gone, is it completely neutral?
What is depression?
If depression becomes stronger, does it necessarily last longer?
What is a channel?
If a channel closes, does nothing get through?
What is gain?
If the gain goes up, does every response get bigger?
What is an oscillation?
If an oscillation stops, is everything inactive?
What is a lesion?
If a lesion heals, does everything work normally again?
What is a threshold?
Once the threshold is crossed, is there no going back?
